versions.note: Publication copy of the installed source. Its exact bytes remain in git history at the initial commit.

changes: The controller records the adapter-measured display at start_test and refuses an out-of-display tap before calling the adapter. No input is sent, the guest is not stopped, and no source write or rebuild is required. The refusal still uses one work action; cancellation and deadline expiry still stop the job.

Observations return uiSummary, and taps return afterUiSummary: bounded visible text and controls with bounds and actual-pixel centers, parsed from the guest view tree with declarations refused and size, depth, node and element limits. The view tree is timed separately from its screenshot.
The report links the post-tap view tree and counts it when unavailable.
Tool schema and skill guidance describe actual-pixel coordinates; validation errors name the rejected field and the action's accepted fields.
versions.unchangedLimits: 8 source writes, 3 builds, 40 work actions, 5-60 minute job deadline, worker and emulator isolation, model and provider checks.

fixtureTests.host: Linux cloud container; no Studio, Docker daemon, SDK, emulator or model was used

versions.deploymentNote: This publication copy keeps /CONFIGURE placeholders. A deployment must apply the reviewed diff to the installed source through the private guarded updater with fresh identity, baseline and idle-resource checks. install.py is not an update command.
